title: Crazy Taxi
description: Sega's open-city taxi arcade hit, on the console it defined — the repo's first Dreamcast target, whose oracle plays it from cold boot to a boarded fare. The three courses ship here assembled from the game's own streaming containers: the model format was read off the renderer's block walker, and every texture is decoded from the disc alone through the descriptor arrays baked into the game binary — offsets, formats and mip layouts all verified byte-exact against the running game's video memory.
